# Mirage 1.0.6

本版本重点改进从旧版下载目录升级时的数据迁移、Steam 创意工坊下载稳定性与登录启动，并优化已安装壁纸预览和场景绳索粒子的渲染兼容性。

## 迁移与兼容性

- 现在会自动检测 V1.0.5 之前由 Mirage 下载到旧 SteamCMD 目录的创意工坊壁纸，并在确认后将其移动到新的 Mirage 下载目录。迁移不会覆盖已有项目；未迁移的壁纸仍可在资料库中使用。
- 迁移壁纸时会同步更新各显示器的壁纸分配、运行时设置、播放列表、收藏、快捷键、信任记录和屏幕保护程序配置，避免目录变化导致既有设置失效。
- 修复场景壁纸的绳索与拖尾粒子在 CPU 几何生成路径中忽略作者细分设置的问题；现在会按细分值生成平滑的贝塞尔曲线，并为新增顶点预留正确容量。

## 修复

- 改进 Steam 会话恢复：临时认证或连接故障会进行有界重试，不再误删有效的已保存会话；钥匙串读取、写入和删除错误也会明确反馈。
- 每次创意工坊下载和重试现在使用独立任务标识，避免上一次尝试的取消或迟到事件影响新任务；同时明确区分用户取消与意外中断，并保证只发送一次完成状态。
- 使用独立的登录项辅助程序处理“登录时启动”，自动迁移旧注册方式；后台登录启动不再错误显示主窗口，手动启动仍会转发到已运行的 Mirage 实例。

## 性能与文档

- 已安装壁纸预览改用统一的缩略图降采样与内存缓存，并限制大型动画预览的解码开销；不可见或停止动画的项目会及时释放动画数据，降低浏览大型资料库时的内存与 CPU 占用。
- 恢复批量获取已订阅 Wallpaper Engine 创意工坊内容的指南，说明如何通过 Valve SteamCMD 下载订阅项目并将目录接入 Mirage；Mirage 内置下载服务仍保持独立。

## 下载

- `arm64`：Apple Silicon Mac
- `x86_64`：Intel Mac
- 系统要求：macOS 14.2 或更高版本

当前构建使用临时签名，首次打开时可能需要在「系统设置 → 隐私与安全性」中选择“仍要打开”。

# Mirage 1.0.6

This release focuses on migrating data from legacy download folders, improving Steam Workshop download stability and login launch behavior, and optimizing installed-wallpaper previews and Scene rope-particle rendering compatibility.

## Migration and Compatibility

- Mirage now detects Workshop wallpapers downloaded by pre-1.0.5 versions into the legacy SteamCMD folders and, after confirmation, moves them into the new Mirage Downloads folder. Migration never overwrites an existing item, and wallpapers that remain in legacy folders stay available in the library.
- When wallpapers move, Mirage updates display assignments, runtime settings, playlists, favorites, shortcuts, trust records, and screen-saver configuration so existing setup continues to work with the new paths.
- Fixed Scene wallpaper rope and trail particles ignoring authored subdivision settings on the CPU geometry-generation path. Mirage now emits smooth Bezier subsegments and reserves the correct vertex capacity for them.

## Fixes

- Improved Steam session restoration. Temporary authentication or connection failures now receive bounded retries without deleting a valid saved session, and Keychain read, write, and deletion failures are reported clearly.
- Each Workshop download and retry now has an independent attempt identifier, preventing cancellation or late events from a previous attempt from affecting a new one. User cancellation and unexpected interruption are distinguished, and completion is emitted exactly once.
- Added a dedicated login-item helper and automatic migration from the previous registration method. Login launches no longer show the main window unexpectedly, while manual launches still forward to an existing Mirage instance.

## Performance and Documentation

- Installed-wallpaper previews now share thumbnail downsampling and memory caching while limiting the decode cost of large animations. Off-screen items and previews that stop animating release animation data promptly, reducing memory and CPU use in large libraries.
- Restored the guide for fetching subscribed Wallpaper Engine Workshop content in bulk. It explains how to use Valve's SteamCMD for subscribed items and add that directory to Mirage, while Mirage's embedded downloader remains independent.

## Downloads

- `arm64` for Apple Silicon Mac
- `x86_64` for Intel Mac
- Requires macOS 14.2 or later

Builds use ad-hoc signing; macOS may require “Open Anyway” under System Settings → Privacy & Security on first launch.
